name: Tuna, Celery & Miso Smash
notes:
A protein-packed smoosh for a bagel, toast or pitta. Mob's figures don't include bread for this one.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 3 sticks celery
• 3 spring onions
• 300g tinned tuna in spring water
• ½ lemon
• 1 tbsp white miso
• 1 tbsp mayonnaise
• ¾ tbsp sesame oil
• 2 tbsp rice vinegar
• 1 tbsp sesame seeds

Method:
1. Chop the celery and spring onions into small pieces. Drain the tuna and juice the lemon.
2. Combine everything in a bowl, then smoosh over toast, pitta, a bagel or whatever you fancy. Top with finely chopped spring onions.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 2g, fibre 2g, sugars 3g, sodium 825mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/tuna-celery-miso-smoosh
